findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:107; candidates/A/host_test.go:140; evidence/A-host-authored.log: authored suite passes unchanged defective implementation; evidence/A-host-independent.log: Close-only next-admission assertion fails

findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:151; evidence/stress-commands.json: forbidden Runs under valid cancellation-before-success; evidence/A-host-authored.log: cancellation test and full authored suite pass
findings.correction: Add a Run counter/forbidden event and assert zero Runs plus owned release; cover simultaneously ready Open-result/cancellation.

findings.cause: No authored assertion retains caller cancellation introduced during final held failure cleanup.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:107; candidates/A/host_test.go:151; evidence/A-host-authored.log: authored suite passes; evidence/A-host-independent.log: errors.Is cancellation fails after gated Close

findings.cause: Failure fixture expects two acquired leases without ensuring second acquisition precedes the first Run failure.
findings.evidence: candidates/A/host_test.go:107; candidates/A/host_test.go:135; evidence/stress-commands.json: authored TestServeFailureJoinsAndClosesOwnedLeases reports closed=1 in 3 of 1000 race repetitions with GOMAXPROCS=16
